docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A portfolio of plates of Indian architecture, sculpture, painting and handicraft, chosen and introduced by Coomaraswamy, named for Viśvakarmā, the divine craftsman (London, 1913). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Visvakarma : examples of Indian architecture, sculpture, painting, handicraft · Coomaraswamy, Ananda K. · 1913, 17 scanned pages. Published 1913; Ananda K. Coomaraswamy died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
